verdict.rationale: Algolia documents a public REST Search API for searching, configuring, and managing indices and records, including header-based authentication and retry and high-availability guidance. It also offers SLA-covered official API clients in nine or more languages and a CLI built on those APIs for scripts and CI. A community user independently notes the API has stayed stable and required zero maintenance. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec found (all probed OpenAPI paths returned 404).
